description: The floors the pull-request subset enforces, recorded from one real run of score.py --subset ci (contrib/corpus/results/score-ci.json). Each entry names the item, the dotted path into its score entry, and the smallest value the run accepts; a path that no longer resolves counts as a drop. Floors exist only for the items the subset runs and only for numbers the labels can judge. supply-chain-fixture-ci carries no floor: cdx-audit 13.8.0, the version the job installs, predates the options dep-scan's audit passes, so the category is not assessed until the job installs cdxgen 13.9.0 or later. The binary-hardening recall floor is 6 of 7 because blint does not report CHECK_RELRO on the unprotected build, which build.sh links with -z norelro.

tools.platform: linux/amd64, an ubuntu:24.04 container with the runner's gcc 13.3
tools.vdb: the full flavour created 2026-11-26; the job pulls vdb7-app-2y, which keeps application advisories of every year
